messages:
deploybot: Scheduled canary rollout started for service=router v=3.14.0 -> 10% in eu-west-1 (window: 22:00-02:00 UTC). run_id=rb-2149990000
carla: seeing increased 95p tail latency on kv-cache after the model swap. Noticed at ~22:04 UTC :warning:
sre-ian: confirmed. spike to 420ms vs baseline 120ms. added paging on the incident channel.
alice: is this tied to the new quantized kernel in v3.14.0? logs show KV cache misses rising.
dan: repro locally with the same build using a longer seqlen test. latency jumps when cache is cold.
pm-ana: hold the rollout? We have traffic hitting canary. We should avoid expanding until fixed.
carla: +1 to hold. Suggest pin traffic back to v3.13.7 or pause further canaries and rollback the 10% slice.
deploybot: Action required: /deploy pause canary rb-2149990000 --initiator carla --reason "kv-cache tail latency"
sre-ian: also recommend setting fallback-policy=pin_previous so existing sessions see 3.13.7 until we validate fix.
jose: ops note: if we rollback we need a maintenance window for the DB-side eviction tuning change we applied earlier. that was part of the rollout plan.
alice: minimal repro points to a kernel selection path for quantization that leads to suboptimal KV alignment. I can test a patched kernel in staging tonight.
dan: for safety: roll forward blocked, rollback risky without the eviction tuning revert. prefer traffic pin to 3.13.7 and re-run canary with kernel patch.
pm-ana: proposed plan: 1) immediate canary pause + pin to 3.13.7 2) alice validates kernel patch in staging 3) new canary tomorrow in the 02:00-06:00 UTC change window 4) update release notes and customer incident banner if needed.
carla: fine. I'll update the release schedule and post an incident-triggered release hold message.
deploybot: canary rb-2149990000 paused by carla. status=PAUSED. pinned_version=3.13.7 for existing slices.
sre-ian: I'll open a short postmortem doc and add perf traces. tagging @alice for kernel follow-up.
alice: starting kernel build now. ETA ~3 hours for a validated test.
pm-ana: re: release notes: add a "change" section explaining pause and pin, and a follow-up note for re-rollout. I'll draft and circulate.
jose: ops scheduling: can we aim for the reschedule window at 02:30 UTC tomorrow? that gives SG teams time to validate.
dan: +1 02:30 works for eng. I'll run a longer cold-cache soak before enabling traffic ramp.
carla: thanks everyone. I'll update the release calendar, send a short note to customers in impacted regions, and re-open this thread when we have green on staging. :thumbsup:
deploybot: Note: original release ticket #INF-4823 updated: state=PAUSED by carla, next_attempt=2149999000 (approx).
